basic_details.job_title: NSIC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 42 General Manager, Deputy General Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The National Small Industries Corporation Limited (NSIC), a Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, is filling 42 reserved vacancies in nine posts, from Assistant Manager (E-0, Rs.30,000-1,30,000) to General Manager (E-5, Rs.80,000-2,20,000), on IDA 2017 pay scales. Only SC, ST and OBC (including PwBD) Indian citizens may apply. Apply online through the CAREER section of www.nsic.co.in from 21 November 2026 to 14 December 2026; the signed print-out with a detailed CV must reach NSIC by 21 December 2026, 6:00 p.m.

how_to_apply: Apply online through the CAREER section of www.nsic.co.in. The link is active from 21 November 2026.
Stage 1: register with name, mobile number, email ID and date of birth. Verify the email ID by the verification email, log in and fill in the basic details.
Stage 2: upload self-attested copies of the documents listed below. The colour photograph with white background and the signature must be in JPG/JPEG/PNG format and less than 100 KB.
Stage 3: pay the application fee through NEFT, as applicable (details below).
Stage 4: an Application Number for the post applied for is issued and sent to the registered mobile number by SMS/email. Keep it for future reference.
Take the print-out of the application on A-4 size paper and sign where indicated. Enclose the self-attested documents and a detailed CV.

Send it by Ordinary Post, Registered Post, Speed Post, Courier or by hand to: Deputy General Manager - Human Resources, The National Small Industries Corporation Limited, "NSIC Bhawan", Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi-110020. Tel: 011-26926275, Email: [email protected].
The print-out must be received by 21 December 2026 up to 6:00 p.m. Hard copies received after 6:00 p.m. or after 21 December 2026 will not be considered for short-listing.

Fee payment: NEFT to A/c No. 43207132490, IFSC SBIN0004298, Name: National Small Industries Corporation Limited, State Bank of India, Commercial Branch, 6th Floor, IFCI Tower, Nehru Place, Delhi. Rs.1500 per application; applications without the fee are straightaway rejected, and no other mode of payment is accepted. There is no application fee for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and Departmental candidates. The fee is non-refundable, even if the candidature is rejected or the candidate is not shortlisted. The notice prints no separate last date for fee payment.
Aadhaar card and PAN card.
Passport size photograph and signature (recent colour photograph, white background).

Class X Certificate/School Leaving Certificate as proof of date of birth. In case of a name change: Gazette notification or national newspaper clipping with an affidavit showing the previous and changed name.
Mark-sheets of each year or consolidated mark-sheet and degree of graduation/post graduation; passing certificate, degree and mark-sheets of educational and professional qualifications.
Proof of the university's norms for converting CGPA/OGPA/DGPA into percentage.
Caste certificate (SC, ST, OBC, EWS), if applicable, and PwBD certificate, if applicable, in the Government of India format.

OBC candidates: Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued within 2026 but before the last date of the online application, plus a declaration in the format printed in the notice (Department of Personnel and Training Office Memorandum No.36012/22/93-Estt. (SCT), dated 8-9-1993).

Experience: service certificate showing start and end of employment, OR appointment/offer letter with resignation letter or relieving letter or stamped and signed salary slip, and Income Tax returns with Form 26 AS. Salary slips/certificates are also uploaded online.
Certificate of scale of pay/grade pay/gross salary (monthly) for November 2024 to October 2026.
Hierarchy Certificate where pay scales are not comparable with CDA/IDA scales; detailed CV; documentary proof in case of change of company name or transfer within a group.
Certified Hindi/English translation of any certificate issued in another language, with the application and at the interview.

content_sections.heading: About NSIC
content_sections.text: The notice describes NSIC as a Schedule 'A' premier Mini-Ratna Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises. Its address is NSIC Bhawan, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi-110020. The notice prints its Corporate Identification No. as U74140DL1955GOI002481.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NSIC has notified 42 vacancies in nine post groups. The category break-up below adds up to 11 SC, 7 ST and 24 OBC. The Total column includes PwBD posts; PwBD is the number inside it. A dash in the notice is shown as 0. The notice does not split the Deputy Manager (E-1) Law & Recovery, Business Development and Rajbhasha vacancies, or the Chief Manager (E-3) Law & Recovery and Business Development vacancies, by functional area. The pay scales are in IDA pattern (2017). For all posts, preference shall be given to candidates from CPSEs/Govt./Deemed Govt. Institutions.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Eligibility for age, qualification and experience is determined as on the closing date of the online application, 14 December 2026. One candidate can apply for one post only. "First Class" and the stated minimum marks carry a 5% relaxation in marks for SC/ST/PwBD candidates. The upper age limit and the First Class requirement are relaxable for Departmental employees applying against these direct recruitment posts. The notice gives the age relaxation only as "applicable as per Govt. Rules", with no category-wise years. For the Assistant Manager (F&A) post, the notice also states that selection will be through a Computer Based Test followed by Personal Interview. Experience in a Financial Institution/Scheduled Commercial Banks/NBFC/CPSE/other Public Sector Organisations/Central Govt./State Govt./Multi-lateral Organisations/other Institutions in relevant fields such as business development, handling of metal trades/raw material trading, Digital Marketing, ONDC platform, handling of subsidy matters, appraisal of MSME credit proposals, sanctions, disbursements, customer management, credit monitoring and follow-up, Loan & Recovery Management, Credit Appraisal Exposure etc. (in any relevant field). Sound technical knowledge and hands-on experience in Industry 4.0 and associated emerging technologies, including Industrial Automation, Robotics, Mechatronics, Additive Manufacturing, Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Sensor Technologies and Smart Manufacturing, preferably involving implementation and management of technology-based projects. OR sound technical knowledge and hands-on experience in Computer Science, Information Technology and Industry 4.0-related emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Internet of Things (IoT), Cloud Computing, Big Data Analytics, Cyber Security, Industrial Software Solutions and Digital Transformation, preferably involving implementation and management of technology-based projects. These three posts have the same printed experience rule. The experience must be in a Financial Institution/Scheduled Commercial Banks/NBFC/CPSE/other Public Sector Organisations/Central Govt./State Govt./Multi-lateral Organisations/other Institutions in relevant fields like budgeting, banking, accounts and taxation, risk based audit, resource mobilisation, forex, loan and recovery management, credit appraisal exposure, risk management etc., financial concurrence and regulatory compliance matters related to Finance. Law & Recovery: handling civil/criminal revenue matters such as recovery suits and executions, arbitrations, service matters, cases under the Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorized Occupants) Act, MSMED Act, Revenue Recovery Certificate cases, writs, appeals etc. Business Development: experience in the institutions and fields listed for the General Manager post above (in any relevant field). Law & Recovery: Graduate with First class LL.B degree or First class Five Years Integrated Law

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each post carries an IDA 2017 pay scale: Rs.80,000-2,20,000 (E-5), Rs.70,000-2,00,000 (E-4), Rs.60,000-1,80,000 (E-3), Rs.40,000-1,40,000 (E-1) and Rs.30,000-1,30,000 (E-0). The compensation package includes basic pay, Industrial DA, HRA, perquisites and allowances as per cafeteria approach, EPF and gratuity as per IDA 2017 pattern. Performance Related Pay applies as admissible and as per the Rules of the Corporation. The Corporation also has policies on House Building Advance, Vehicle Advance, Computer Advance, medical facilities for self and dependents, PF, gratuity, Superannuation Pension Scheme and leave encashment. The selected candidate must sign an agreement to serve NSIC for a minimum of 2 years after joining, failing which compensation of Rs.2,00,000 is payable. The waiting list/panel of selected candidates is valid for six months.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection stages differ by post. Scrutiny of applications against the eligibility criteria, followed by a Personal Interview of shortlisted candidates. A Computer Based Test (70% weightage) followed by a Personal Interview of shortlisted candidates (30% weightage). The test has 100 multiple choice questions for 100 marks. Each correct answer carries 1 mark and each wrong answer carries 0.25 negative marking. Minimum qualifying marks are 40 for General/OBC candidates and 35 for SC/ST/PwBD candidates. The notice does not print the date of the Computer Based Test. Candidates are shortlisted for the interview in the ratio of at least 1:5 or maximum 1:7 with respect to the number of posts advertised. Management reserves the right to devise its own criteria, including raising minimum eligibility standards, to restrict the number called for interview. Its decision on eligibility, interview and selection is final and binding.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 42 reserved vacancies in nine posts: 11 for SC, 7 for ST and 24 for OBC, including PwBD posts. Assistant Manager (E-0) Technology has the most posts at 13.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of the online application is 14 December 2026. The signed print-out with a detailed CV must reach NSIC by 21 December 2026 up to 6:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NSIC Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Manager (E-0) Technology needs a first class 4 years B.E./B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in the listed branches, plus a GATE score of 2025 or 2026. Assistant Manager (F&A) needs CA/CMA or a Commerce graduate with Two years MBA (First Class, 60%) in Finance.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years for General Manager, 41 for Deputy General Manager, 38 for Chief Manager, 31 for Deputy Manager and 28 for Assistant Manager, counted as on 14 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.1500 per application, paid through NEFT. SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and Departmental candidates pay no fee, and the fee is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the CAREER section of www.nsic.co.in, then send the signed print-out with a detailed CV and self-attested documents to Deputy General Manager - Human Resources, NSIC, NSIC Bhawan, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi-110020, by 21 December 2026, 6:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NSIC posts?
faq.answer: Posts 1 to 7 use scrutiny of applications and a Personal Interview. Assistant Manager Technology uses 70% GATE score and 30% interview. Assistant Manager (F&A) uses a 70% Computer Based Test and 30% interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The IDA 2017 pay scales are Rs.80,000-2,20,000 for General Manager, Rs.70,000-2,00,000 for Deputy General Manager, Rs.60,000-1,80,000 for Chief Manager, Rs.40,000-1,40,000 for Deputy Manager and Rs.30,000-1,30,000 for Assistant Manager.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets a relaxation in NSIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SC/ST/PwBD candidates get a 5% relaxation in the minimum marks. Age relaxation is "as per Govt. Rules", and 10 years in age and the First Class requirement are relaxable for Departmental employees.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a service bond, and can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates must execute an agreement to serve NSIC for a minimum of 2 years after joining, or pay Rs.2,00,000 as compensation. A candidate can apply for one post only.
